job.title: Contracts Administrator - Brisbane
job.description:
Build Your Career with a Leading Commercial Builder

Siteforce Recruitment is proud to partner with a highly regarded commercial construction company with a strong pipeline of work across Brisbane and South East Queensland.

We are seeking an experienced Contract Administrator to join a collaborative and high-performing team delivering a diverse range of childcare centres, commercial developments and civil infrastructure projects.

Siteforce Recruitment specialises in connecting skilled construction professionals with some of Australia's leading construction companies. We are committed to matching experienced candidates with employers who offer long-term career opportunities and supportive workplace cultures.

Working closely with the Project Manager and site teams, you will be responsible for the commercial management of projects from procurement through to completion.

  • Degree in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering or a related discipline
  • Strong understanding of Queensland building legislation, the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and local construction practices
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Queensland building codes, construction methodologies and compliance requirements
  • Experience with procurement, contract administration, cost control, forecasting, variations and EOTs
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills
  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills
  • Experience using Jobpac, Procore, Cheops or similar construction management software is advantageous

Apply Now

If you're ready to take the next step in your construction career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Chantal at Siteforce Recruitment for a confidential discussion. 0410 928 512 

Applicants must have unrestricted Australian working rights and currently reside in Australia to be considered for this position.
